title: refactor(Development/AbelianVarietyTheory): deduplicate theta-lift multiplicity factoring in TwistedOperators
body:
Generalize `GlobalTheory.Chain.CuspL2.exists_embedding_skew`, `GlobalTheory.Chain.IoLift.exists_factor_kFin`, and `GlobalTheory.Chain.IoLift.exists_mult` to accept an explicit boundedness hypothesis `hbdd : ∀ φ, IsCuspGrow θ V φ → ∃ B : ℝ, ∀ g, ‖φ g‖ ≤ B` instead of `GlobalTheory.Published.CuspDecaySobolev`, and remove the two near-identical rapid-decay copies in `PairThetaLiftFactorsThroughIntertwiner.lean` and `ExistsThetaLiftMultiplicitySpacesOfPublishedStatement.lean`, calling `GlobalTheory.Chain.IoLift.exists_mult` directly in both `pairLifts` and `ioPair_of_rapid`.

Changed declarations:
- `GlobalTheory.Chain.CuspL2.exists_embedding_skew` (in `ExistsEmbeddingSkew.lean`): generalized in place from `GlobalTheory.Published.CuspDecaySobolev` to `hbdd`
- `GlobalTheory.Chain.IoLift.exists_factor_kFin` and `GlobalTheory.Chain.IoLift.exists_mult` (in `ExistsIntegralForm.lean`): generalized in place from `GlobalTheory.Published.CuspDecaySobolev` to `hbdd`

Removed declarations:
- `GlobalTheory.Chain.CuspL2.bounded` (in `ExistsEmbeddingSkew.lean`, unused once `exists_embedding_skew` takes `hbdd`)
- `GlobalTheory.PairLift.RuleLift.bounded`, `GlobalTheory.PairLift.RuleLift.exists_embedding_skew`, `GlobalTheory.PairLift.RuleLift.exists_factor_kFin`, `GlobalTheory.PairLift.RuleLift.exists_mult` (in `PairThetaLiftFactorsThroughIntertwiner.lean`)
- `GlobalTheory.Chain.IoLift.bounded_of_rapid`, `GlobalTheory.Chain.IoLift.exists_embedding_skew_of_rapid`, `GlobalTheory.Chain.IoLift.exists_factor_kFin_of_rapid`, `GlobalTheory.Chain.IoLift.exists_mult_of_rapid` (in `ExistsThetaLiftMultiplicitySpacesOfPublishedStatement.lean`)
